module: "Zone" class of a sites set: a 2D polygon (list of vertices in world coordinates) delimiting a map region, optionally with two planes (top and bottom) bounding the zone in height. Used to test whether a point or vehicle is inside the zone (city limits, traffic zones, mission zones) and to draw it in debug. The module returns a constructor.
usage:
local zone = sites.zones.objects[id]
if zone:containsPoint2D(veh:getPosition()) then print('inside', zone.name) end
print(zone:zoneArea())
notes: The containment test is 2D (parity algorithm on x/y): height only matters through the active top/bot planes (pointBetweenPlanes); with no active plane, the zone is infinite in z.

processVertices sets v.radius = 5 for each vertex and chains the vertices in a loop (v.next / v.prev). It must be called after any manual modification of self.vertices; addVertex, removeVertex and autoPlanes do so.
A zone with no vertices is marked aabb.invalid = true and logs an error.
rayIntersectsZone assumes all vertices have a next field (so processVertices has already been called).
makeHighResolutionFence replaces the vertices with intermediate points (max step 3 m by default), snapped to the terrain if core_terrain exists.
drawFence modifies the a field of the ColorI passed as an argument.

C.desc: Zone object. Fields: sites, id, name, color, vertices (list of {pos, radius, index, next, prev}), center, labelPos, aabb {xMin..zMax, invalid}, top / bot ({pos, normal, active}), fenceDown, fenceHeight, usePlanes, customFields, locations and parkingSpots (filled by finalizeSites).

init.desc: Constructor. sites may be nil (identifier -1). Default values: fenceDown 0, fenceHeight 5, planes inactive.

onSerialize.desc: Serializes name, vertices, color, custom fields and top/bot planes.

onDeserialized.desc: Restores the zone from the data and calls processVertices.

addVertex.desc: Inserts a vertex (at the end or at the given index) and recalculates the derived data.

removeVertex.desc: Removes the vertex at the given index and recalculates.

processVertices.desc: Precomputations: bounding box (aabb), center, label position, vertex chaining, aabb extension by the planes. If a plane is not active, the corresponding z bound is infinite.

changedPlanes.desc: To call after modifying the top/bot planes; reruns processVertices.

validPlanes.desc: Tests that both planes are active and that their normals point up (top) and down (bot) respectively.

autoPlanes.desc: Automatically creates horizontal planes 5 m above the highest vertex and 5 m below the lowest, centered on the zone.

ignoreTop.desc: Do not create the top plane.

ignoreBot.desc: Do not create the bottom plane.

pointBetweenPlanes.desc: Indicates whether a point is between the active planes (an inactive plane is ignored).

vertexPlaneIntersection.desc: Vertically projects (z axis) a vertex onto a plane. Returns the vertex unchanged if the plane is inactive or aligned with the z axis (error logged).

aabbCheck.desc: Quick x/y test against the bounding box (z ignored).

returns.desc: false if outside the box or aabb invalid.

rayIntersectsZone.desc: Intersection distance of a ray with the "fence" (vertical walls along the outline, bounded by fenceDown/fenceHeight or by the planes).

returns.desc: Distance of the nearest hit, math.huge if none.

containsPoint2D.desc: Tests whether a point is inside the polygon (x/y) and between the planes.

containsVehicle.desc: Tests whether a vehicle is inside the zone, based on its spawn bounding box: center only in basic mode, otherwise the four bottom/top corners used (points 0, 3, 4 and 7) must all be inside the zone.

drawDebug.desc: Draws the zone in debug (translucent fence, name, planes depending on the mode). Only draws if the camera is close enough.

nearCam.desc: Only draw the segments close to the camera.

drawFence.desc: Draws a fence panel (two triangles, double-sided) between two points.

usePlanes.desc: Bound the fence by the active planes.

nearCam.desc: Limit to camera proximity with fade.

drawPlane.desc: Draws a plane (top or bottom) with lines linking its anchor point to the projected vertices, and its normal.

drawMinimap.desc: Draws the zone outline on the UI minimap (white lines).

td.desc: Minimap drawing object (line method), inferred from code.

makeHighResolutionFence.desc: Replaces the vertices with a version sampled every maxStep meters (at least 1), snapped to the terrain height.

maxStep.desc: Maximum step in meters; default 3, floor 1.

zoneArea.desc: Polygon area in m² (shoelace formula, x/y). 0 if fewer than 3 vertices.
